verdicts.reason: A just shrinks the banner into a thin strip across the middle of the portrait canvas. About 80% of the canvas is dead space, and the body copy, badges and CTA are tiny enough to be unreadable. B actually rearranges into a vertical stack, but the logo is oversized and becomes the focal point, competing with the headline. The badges are reversed from the original order (LIMITED SPOTS before FREE), and they float far from the copy at the top. The gaps between badges, headline, body and logo are uneven, and the bottom is left loose below the CTA.
